reading.action: Keep the fire going to bring the rivet back to full (gathering a little more fuel as needed); pull HALF the rivet's Ember-essence and bind it into the rusted iron bar (Essence Infusion); then bank the fire, lie down, and SLEEP to recover from the second floor's efforts.

partB_bind.pole: SAME (Ember into iron — his own element)

reading.result: PART A (refill) — trivial upkeep. Fed the brazier from the low armful + a little nearby scrounging, ran the rivet back up to full in the coals. Stamina -3 (gathering; washed out by the rest). | PART B (bind into bar) — CLEAN / EXCELLENT (margin 24). SAME-POLE (Ember into iron, his own element) so NO polarity tax — the opposite of the cold stone's fight. He pulled half the rivet's Ember-essence and bound it into the rusted iron bar in one steady, controlled motion; it took and HELD, warm and stable — his first genuinely CLEAN Essence Infusion. This is the qualifying Apprentice DEMO (Novice->Apprentice gate = 1 clean holding bind without heavy struggle; margin 24 is exactly that). SKILL ADVANCED: Essence Infusion Novice -> APPRENTICE (displayed 5 -> 7). The bar now holds a steady bound Ember-charge (latent; effect emergent in use — NOT assigning a combat number unprompted). NO affinity tick: this is SKILL work (handling/binding into an object), not absorption into himself -> Ember Manipulation stays 3. COST: Focus -8 (low; compatible, strong roll). Rivet back to half, in coals. | PART C (sleep / recover) — long real rest by the banked fire in the CLEARED floor 2 (safe; no event invented). Pools recover toward full (imperfect — hard ground, no food/med): HP 57->76, Focus 32->104 (post-bind), Stamina 15->52. NET turn deltas (start-of-turn -> end): HP +19, Focus +64, Stamina +34. | NO Tower reset.
